questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to meet deadlines at work every time
Why we put things off, and how to stop
How comedians write and plan their shows
Why cavemen lived such short lives
questions.why: Sam says they're discussing procrastination – delaying things that must be done.

questions.q: Why does Sam say she leaves her work until the last minute?
options: She works better as a deadline gets near
She has too many other jobs to do first
Her boss always gives her work very late
She often forgets about it completely
questions.why: She says, 'I work better when a deadline is approaching.'

questions.q: Which of these does Neil link to procrastination?
options: Better sleep and more energy
Higher pay and faster promotion
More friends and a busier social life
More stress and less career success
questions.why: He says procrastinators have higher stress, lower wellbeing and lower financial and career success.

questions.q: What reason has comedian Eshaan Akbar given himself for procrastinating?
options: He doesn't like his job
He's too tired to start early
He works better under pressure
He has poor time management
questions.why: He says he has told himself he procrastinates because he works better under pressure.

questions.q: How does Sam describe her own reason for procrastinating?
options: An emotional reaction to a mountain of work
Her time management has always been poor
She secretly enjoys being late for things
She gets bored easily when work is slow
questions.why: She says it's an emotional response: she sees a mountain of work and feels threatened.

questions.q: Why does Neil mention our cave-dwelling ancestors?
options: To show that they never put things off at all
Acting on impulse helped then but not now
To say they were better at managing their time
To show that life was much easier in the past
questions.why: He says being impulsive was good back then, but today it makes us distracted and we procrastinate.

questions.q: What does Eshaan say he doesn't understand?
options: Why people procrastinate at all
Why his friends always finish work early
Why he can never find any time to relax
Why he prefers last-minute pressure
questions.why: He says he needs to understand why he prefers that over 'the calm serenity' of finishing with lots of time.

questions.q: Which advice does Neil give for avoiding procrastination?
options: Work only at night when it is quiet
Ask someone else to do the hardest parts
Break tasks up and forgive past delays
Set more deadlines and stick to them
questions.why: He suggests breaking the task into smaller stages and forgiving yourself for procrastinating in the past.
